cards.title: The cache leaves the GPU
cards.question: Why can inference need more than HBM?
cards.selfCheck: Long contexts strain GPU memory; test SSD offload latency and attach.
cards.prompt: Hypothesis: tiering KV cache into host memory and SSDs expands memory content when latency permits. Compare time-to-first-token, cache hit rates and cost per token. cards.selfCheck: Server LPDDR sales more than doubled QoQ; test repeat volume.

cards.question: What would upgrade the memory thesis?
cards.selfCheck: WAIT: next report vs $61.5B sales and 86.25% adjusted GM guide.
cards.prompt: Educational framework: next fiscal Q1 report, expected within weeks, date not verified. Compare guidance, enterprise SSD mix and cash after capex. Reject durability thesis if pricing and repeat orders weaken together. cards.title: Follow the bytes per token
cards.question: How do you spot the next memory bottleneck?
cards.selfCheck: Model cache bytes per request × concurrency; test tiering economics.
cards.prompt: Compare HBM, host DRAM and SSD capacity, bandwidth and latency. Compression and cache reuse may offset growth.
